estimated_approach.basis: USFS 5024 identifies Hatchet Lake and Hatchet River.
The portage inventory identifies the One Island and Portage Lake carry.
USFS 7196 identifies the Isabella River carry.
The Maude Lake trail and mapped landing are adjacent to this shore.
Royal River centerlines in both DNR and NHD data pass this end of the trail.

estimated_approach.water: Hula Lake Outlet toward Wood Lake
estimated_approach.basis: The Sourdough Creek trail approaches DNR Hula Lake Outlet (NHD Madden Creek). Passage to Wood Lake is unverified and water levels vary.
